top.theme: part 2: at the next family lunch she finally answers the aunty who keeps asking when she will marry, gently and without shame
top.hook: Jesus... Aunty asked when I'm getting married. This time I answered her. 💍

top.theme: his visa was rejected a second time and he can't tell if he's still waiting on a door or banging on a wall
top.hook: Jesus... the visa got rejected again. ✈️

top.theme: exhausted after a third late night, he fell asleep in the office washroom and told his manager he was on a call
top.hook: Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨

top.theme: her ex posted a photo with his new girlfriend and she liked it so he would think she is fine
top.hook: Jesus... he posted a photo with her today. I liked it so he'd think I'm fine. 💔

top.theme: her best friend at work got the promotion she trained her for, and she clapped first while envy ate at her
top.hook: Jesus... my best friend got the promotion I trained her for. I clapped first. 👏

bottom.theme: the two-year plan she built her future on collapsed in one email and she is grieving the person she thought she'd become
bottom.hook: Jesus... my two-year plan fell apart in one email.

bottom.theme: she is in a long low season and every post telling her to count her blessings makes the dark feel worse
bottom.hook: Jesus... every reel tonight said count your blessings. 😔

bottom.theme: a viewer's comment: she forgave someone close but cannot trust her again, and feels hollow
bottom.hook: Jesus... I forgave her. I just can't let her back in. 🥀

bottom.theme: he coasts through his waiting season passing time, scrolling till sleep, with nothing he is getting ready for
bottom.hook: Jesus... I'm just passing time this season. 🍂

bottom.theme: she loves her family but they cannot read what she is carrying, so she gives Amma half the story and feels loneliest at home
bottom.hook: Jesus... my family loves me, but they don't understand me. 💔

top.theme: she always texts first and wonders if anyone would notice if she stopped
top.hook: Jesus... I stopped texting first for a day. Nobody checked on me. 💔

top.theme: he eats lunch on the office staircase every day and calls it a choice, but really no one ever asked him to join
top.hook: Jesus... I eat lunch on the office staircase every day. 🍱

top.theme: good things finally arrived for him and he cannot enjoy any of it, always waiting for the catch
top.hook: Jesus... good news came. I can't enjoy it. 🙂

top.theme: no time for himself anymore, everything is for others
top.hook: Jesus... I gave away my Sunday, my evenings, even my lunch break. Nothing was mine. 😔

top.theme: he has prayed the same prayer for two years with no change and wonders if God is tired of hearing it
top.hook: Jesus... Two years. The same prayer. Nothing has moved. 🕯️

bottom.theme: his small shop hasn't turned a profit in a year and he can't tell hope apart from stubbornness
bottom.hook: Jesus... the shop hasn't made a profit in a year. 🏪

bottom.hook: Jesus... I keep waiting to feel ready before I start.
